about: How tall each logo draws on the Area Map with Traffic Counts, in CSS px at the map's 672 px width. default_px applies to every logo. logos scales a logo on every map; listings scales logos on one listing, where "*" means every logo on it. Logos are named by file, as in build/logos.json, without .png. The first match wins: the listing's own name, then logos, then the listing's "*", else 1. A scaled height is rounded to the nearest whole px, halves up. Read by lib/logos.py.
